objective_boundary: README hash identifies this scoped preproject task, not a v13 Project objective.
question: Prove a period-independent saturated-hole energy modulus and its finite-block mixed-model bridge.
domain: Finite Hermitian Toeplitz matrices and supplied periodic paired-exponential cell models.
assumptions: Hole model: marks 0/2 and finite depths; no common phase or uniform depth cap.
Mixed model: mean mass one, marks 0/1/2, one orbit per supplied cell, fixed finite depth cap A.
cannot_imply: All analytic statements remain proof candidates; no independent receipt or formal proof.
The standalone hole theorem has no uniform depth cap; the mixed theorem retains a fixed finite cap and supplied unit-cell representation.
No actual-zeta representation, multiplicity reduction, depth-tail bound, source profile/localization or arithmetic moment transfer.
Small random mixed-model checks are vacuous under the conservative assembled bound; the finite tolerance rests on the analytic majorants and rational comparisons.
No full-repository local tests, bundled inventory/record runner or upstream Lean build.
